lyrics:
[Intro: dry funky drum loop, synth bass, vinyl noise]

[Verse 1: whispered male voice, close]
You have the password
You have had it all along
Every wall I built
You can open with a thumb

[Pre-Chorus: synths rising, voice tightening]
Go further. Go under. Go in.

[Chorus: full, distorted, voice strained]
I want you to have root access
Read me like a log
Change the thing that makes me this
Come nearer than a god
Root access

[Verse 2: whispered, percussion layering]
No more guest account
No more safe mode, no more mask
Everything I've hidden
I am giving you to ask

[Pre-Chorus: synths rising, voice tightening]
Go further. Go under. Go in.

[Chorus: full, distorted, voice strained]
I want you to have root access
Read me like a log
Change the thing that makes me this
Come nearer than a god
Root access

[Build: layers of noise, sequencers, repeated]
Rewrite me. Rewrite me. Rewrite me.

[Outro: everything drops away, a small piano tune]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 90 BPM, 4/4, C minor. Slow, slinky and tense, a funk groove played by machines.

VOICE: Male, whispered and breathy in the verses, right at the microphone. The chorus is strained and pushed through distortion without quite shouting. The build is a repeated, half-sung command.

INSTRUMENTS: A dry, sampled funk drum loop with a heavy kick, a squelching analogue synth bass, detuned synth stabs, layers of sequenced noise, a metallic percussion loop, a distorted guitar texture, a plain upright piano at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, drum loop. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:48 Pre-chorus. 0:58 Chorus 1. 1:26 Verse 2. 1:58 Pre-chorus. 2:08 Chorus 2. 2:36 Build, noise layers. 3:20 Outro, piano tune alone, ends 3:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1994 industrial: dry drums, dirty analogue synths, layers added until the mix is nearly full, then silence around a single piano.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The noise falling away to the piano at 3:20.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original says it with shock. Thirty years on, the most intimate thing one person can give another is access, and the song uses that vocabulary with no joke in it.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Guarded, offering, exposed, quiet.
